moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio t-energy, written here): 4000 ms loop: an energy curve e(u) is drawn (establish 0–25 %, build 25–60 %, climax 60–75 %, resolve 75–100 %); a dot runs along it and a star scales 0.6 + 0.5·e, shaking ±2 px (24 fps, seeded hash) when e > 0.8. Rule: plan one intensity shape for the whole film. Params: phases (25 / 60 / 75 %) · peak (0.95). Plan one intensity shape for the whole film: establish (0–25 %), build (25–60 %), climax (60–75 %), resolve.
